capabilities: create timestamped notes in a specified pages folder
add a + button to the left sidebar
open the newly created note automatically
create notes from the command palette
extras: README is written in Chinese; it includes install and development instructions but no usage screenshots, and ends with a WeChat donation request.
problem: Obsidian has no one-click way to create a new note with a timestamp filename in a fixed folder, which Logseq users keeping a pages directory need.

relations.evidence: 与 Logseq 的 pages 目录结构完全兼容

summary: Sidebar button and command that create a timestamp-named note (yyyymmddhhmm.md) in a chosen pages folder and open it immediately.
